findings.risk: A policy package could become a parallel graph state owner.
findings.mitigation: The package has no database/table and only PolicyDeltaBuilder imports canonical GraphDeltaBuilder; GraphStateCustody remains the sole commit owner.

findings.risk: Mutable source task, graph, registry or scheduler projections could change after a policy decision.
findings.mitigation: Builders copy into deeply immutable canonical value objects; tests mutate source projections after construction and observe no snapshot change.

findings.risk: A valid graph signature could be paired with forged node role/capability/state content.
findings.mitigation: Projector checks graph ID/revision/signature and compares every policy node to the current GraphStateCustody snapshot before projection.

findings.risk: A mechanism at input_precheck could be presented as activation-ready.
findings.mitigation: Canonical mutation requires the exact pair activation_ready and deterministic_ready; unavailable and premature stage tests fail closed.

findings.risk: Topology operations could omit permission, use unregistered roles, or bypass privacy/capacity/lease/budget limits.
findings.mitigation: The symbolic projector rejects missing or denied permission, unknown registry values, placement without resource, stale/missing telemetry, privacy/capacity/lease failures and all configured budgets.

findings.risk: Retry-specific random IDs or timestamps could map one idempotency key to different graph delta content.
findings.mitigation: Delta, mutation and event IDs plus graph payload timestamps derive from proposal semantics; builds with different decision receipt IDs have identical canonical delta IDs and digests.

findings.risk: Stale, cycle, concurrent rebase or write conflict paths could be reported as successful commits.
findings.mitigation: Real SQLite GraphStateCustody tests prove reject, replay, rebase and conflict dispositions, explicit fallback and unchanged revision on rejection.

findings.risk: A stored policy artifact could be replayed after byte or schema tampering.
findings.mitigation: Replay verifies artifact revision/SHA-256, contract digest, schema version and schema/contract-kind agreement; tamper and future-version tests reject.

findings.risk: Contract availability could be mistaken for activation of ARG, CARD, AgentPrune or MaAS.
findings.mitigation: No mechanism is wired into the default profile; frozen Phase 2 policy validation reports strongest_activation_eligible=false and the review records this slice as contract-only.
